name: PetalStack
tagline: The client operating system for modern wedding professionals.
positioning: PetalStack unifies inquiries, contracts, timelines, and payments into one system of record for florists, planners, and photographers running their own studios.

hero.h1: Run every wedding from a single system of record.
hero.sub: From first inquiry to final invoice, PetalStack consolidates your leads, proposals, contracts, and event timelines so owner-operators can scale bookings without adding overhead.

features.title: Inquiry pipeline that converts
features.description: Route web forms, referrals, and venue leads into one pipeline with automated follow-ups and response-time SLAs so no couple slips through.

features.title: Proposals and contracts
features.description: Send branded quotes, e-signature contracts, and deposit requests in a single thread—no more chasing PDFs across email.

features.title: Event-day timelines
features.description: Build minute-by-minute wedding-day timelines and share them with couples and vendors in real time.

features.title: Revenue forecasting
features.description: Track booked revenue, outstanding balances, and seasonal capacity across every event on your calendar.

features.title: Automated payments
features.description: Schedule deposits, trigger payment reminders, and reconcile balances tied directly to each signed contract.

features.title: Team handoffs
features.description: Assign leads and events to seats with role-based access so your associates never miss a handoff.

testimonials.quote: We replaced three spreadsheets and a shared inbox with PetalStack. Our booking response time dropped from two days to under an hour.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vance

testimonials.quote: The event timeline module alone justified the cost. Every vendor shows up knowing exactly where to be, down to the minute.
testimonials.name: Devon Ashcroft

testimonials.quote: As a two-person studio, per-seat pricing meant we only paid for what we used. The forecasting helped us book smarter in the off-season.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For owner-operators managing their own book of weddings.
For growing studios coordinating a team across every event.
For multi-location firms and franchise operators.

homepage.footerBlurb: PetalStack is the client operating system for wedding professionals—built for the florists, planners, and photographers who run the business themselves.
